content:
The latest macOS 26.7 beta version appears to have leaked several upcoming Apple home products, including an all-new HomePod mini, a security camera, a Siri Remote designed for the next-generation Apple TV 4K, and the much-time device called HomePad.

After an in-depth analysis of the code, several important clues about HomePad's specifications have also emerged……

Engadget's Filipe Espósito discovered that HomePad will most likely run a variant version of tvOS, but its operation may be closer to that of a giant Apple Watch.

The code also reveals a rather interesting privacy feature: HomePad will only display your personal information on the Widget when it detects that your iPhone is nearby.

We expect HomePad to launch in two versions: one with a basic speaker, looking similar to the HomePod; the other designed for wall mounting.

In addition to the other Apple home products I mentioned earlier, the code also mentions some yet-to-be-announced devices. I sincerely hope one of them is a smart doorbell. Which Apple home product are you most looking forward to? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.
